routes.rationale: Surface power and storage constrain operating time and survival through darkness.
routes.next_step: Check the full source for power-system changes and propose a daylight/darkness energy-budget comparison.
routes.acceptance_criteria: A sourced parameter table with units and uncertainty, plus a proposed energy-budget test with an explicit pass/fail criterion.

routes.rationale: Mobility and surface interactions affect traverse feasibility and vehicle assumptions.
routes.next_step: Identify the relevant vehicle or terrain evidence and propose a terrain/mobility sensitivity test.
routes.acceptance_criteria: Document source applicability and a bounded sensitivity test; distinguish measured values from assumed ranges.

routes.rationale: Relay availability and line of sight constrain blackout periods and remote operations.
routes.next_step: Check relay and navigation capability changes and propose an outage or coverage test.
routes.acceptance_criteria: A traceable coverage/outage scenario with source-backed inputs or explicitly marked unknowns.

routes.rationale: Resource production and construction can change cargo demand, power demand, and base dependencies.
routes.next_step: Extract capability maturity and resource/power requirements; propose a mass-and-energy balance study.
routes.acceptance_criteria: An explicit study proposal with units, evidence gaps, and a check that a solicitation is not treated as deployed hardware.

routes.rationale: Mission and delivery changes can alter landing, commissioning, and campaign dependencies.
routes.next_step: Compare the source against the mission register and identify any schedule, payload, site, or readiness changes.
routes.acceptance_criteria: A cited before/after comparison that preserves target dates and distinguishes plans from completed events.
